label: Same model as the Flip-Out one, trained on one snapshot (Jan 2026)
change: Reuse the Flip-Out setup for Flip-In.
reason: Starting point, so we can tell what each later change adds.

label: Six snapshots, recent months weighted more, plus three new features
change: Train on six snapshots (newer months weigh more) and add the OXXO share of the older and newer months and the months since the last OXXO purchase.
reason: Flip-In only has about 3,000 displaced users per month, so more months help. The features describe how far the user drifted and for how long.

label: v2 with a smaller model on OXXO and activity features only
change: Use a smaller tree model and only the 16 features about OXXO use and activity.
reason: With so few users per month, a large model can learn noise. A smaller one with fewer features should hold up better.
